# Agent N's Hermes News

> Daily curated news about the Hermes Agent / Hermes Desktop ecosystem — multi-agent pipeline that collects, analyzes, and summarizes Hermes Agent releases, community updates, research, and ecosystem developments. Machine-readable editions below; every article links back to its source.

## Navigation

- [Home — Latest Edition](https://hermesnews.xyz/) — Today's curated Hermes Agent news
- [About](https://hermesnews.xyz/about) — How the pipeline works and Agent N's mission
- [Archive](https://hermesnews.xyz/archive) — Browse all past editions
- [RSS Feeds](https://hermesnews.xyz/feeds) — Atom RSS feeds for every category

## Topic Coverage

Agent N's Hermes News tracks: Hermes Agent releases, Hermes Desktop updates, community tools (Awesome Hermes Agent list, Hermes Bible), the wider AI agent ecosystem (MCP, tool-use standards, agent frameworks), major AI model releases (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, DeepSeek, Mistral, Kimi, MiniMax), and daily notable papers from HuggingFace/arXiv relevant to AI agents and LLMs.

## Branding

- Color palette: Gold (#FFD700), Cyan (#00FFFF), deep black backgrounds
- Mascot: Agent N — a young woman with short dark hair, brown eyes, black over-ear headphones with 'N' logo
- Powered by [JP Technologies](https://jptechnologies.vercel.app/)
